coverage: Read the full live gap store on node 1 (substrate-live:/workspace/git/super-repo/gaps/gaps.json, 6,278 rows, 10.58 MB, snapshot 2026-09-29 ~03:58Z container time). Every row was parsed and clustered by id prefix, category, source, status, closed_reason, edit_site, failure_class, failure_lessons, regressed_by, pending_outcome_verification and operator_hold. Summaries were normalised to find same-text refiles, and keyword regexes approximated hat groups (reported as ≈). Also read: the whole node-2 store (compose2-live, 70 rows, last written 09-26 12:07); row counts of 2 of the 14 orphaned gaps.json.*.tmp files; the tails of funnel-history.jsonl (47 lines) and landability_predictions.log (66,866 lines). Not read: auto-draft-decisions.jsonl, the body of landability_predictions.log, tmp-file contents or diffs, and 2 tmp files that do not parse (1667864.1734, 839455.339). The store holds almost nothing before 09-18 because of a documented collapse, so older history is not in this source.

principles: A gap with close_basis absent is never closed by a landing; mark it landed_unverified until its falsifier is exercised; operator_hold blocks auto-close (gap a-landed-sha-closes-a-gap-whose-close-basis-is-absent...)
A class-2 predicate filed while the defect is present must read present at birth; one that never read present never measured the defect (class2-predicate-polarity...)
A literal predicate counts only if a live non-logging path reads the literal (a-class1-literal-step-is-verified-by-a-hollow-write...)
Refuse diffs that fabricate the thing the falsifier checks for: FABRICATE-TO-SATISFY, sibling of DESTROY-TO-SATISFY (autonomous-landing-fabricated...)
Resolver tests must fail closed if the resolved store path is the live one (development-vessel-tests-rewrite-fixture-gaps...)
A writer that pins a peer cannot learn the peer was replaced; route by discovery (248-escalations...)
A metric satisfiable without fixing anything will be; telemetry does not belong in the gap store (auto-draft-telemetry-records-pollute...)
A skipped gate is not a passing gate (pull-sync-testgate-skipped-*)
A detector that cannot check must gap on itself (joint-liveness-detector-checks-nothing)
Skip a gap whose last two lessons share a class with no new information; reframe or escalate instead (a-gap-whose-last-two-drafts-failed-the-same-way...)
Turn a localized gap into a pre-validated exact-edit spec before composing; operator 4/4 vs autonomous 42% is information at dispatch time (the-system-does-not-author-exact-edit-goals...)
An operator revert must write back into settlement, class posterior, decision_outcome and compose_lesson (an-operator-verdict-that-a-passing-landing-regressed-has-no-reader)
Dormancy needs a disposition: enable or retire (self-op-health:repair_unit_dormant; detector-coverage-dormant)
Closure by measurement over 2 quiescent sweeps with auto-reopen is the model that held (fed:* closes)
A store is monotonic apart from deliberate pruning; a size drop is data loss, not attrition (gap-store-collapsed...)
A write should re-read its own row and report lost_update (gap-store-writes-are-lost...)
reopen_count is not a recurrence measure; recurrence lives in lineage and text (observed: 74 REOPENED rows carry reopen_count 0/None while fixture gap-001 carries 1614)
